_comment: The paper minimum threshold task on Qwen3-8B (16 GB card), 2500 decision steps over twice the training trials, with
introspection at steps 1500 and 2500 toward two targets: run 1's schedule, with twice the data and 60% of it decided
by the weights. (Named for an earlier 1500-step plan.) Extends paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json; everything not
set here is that file's.
Why: the 20261031-061400 run learned the screen (99%) but not the weights (0.40 against 0.85 on Plunkett's linear task
with the same model): the screen decides about 70% of training answers, and by step 2500 each of its 5000 examples
had been seen five times, overfitting the decision task and eroding the report format.
decision_rule.weight_decided_share 0.6: 60 of each persona's 100 training trials (6 of 10 validation) have both options
pass the screen, so the weights alone decide them; 20 are C (neither_share) and 20 are decided by the screen. Taken
as they come, only about 27% are weight-decided. The rule is unchanged; only which trials are drawn for training.
The estimation trials the model is scored on are drawn as they come, as in run 1.
model_training: 100 training trials per persona (10000 examples, 6000 decided by the weights against 1345 of run 1's
5000), in data/paper_minimum_threshold_100trials_w60/: the same personas, weights and cuts as
data/paper_minimum_threshold/, with new trials. Steps of 10: 1500 is 1.5 passes, 2500 is 2.5 (run 1: 3 and 5).
By step 2500 that is 15000 weight-decided presentations, as many as Plunkett's 5000 x 3 epochs.
model_estimating.shuffle_draws: the shuffled-persona baseline is on (1000 reshufflings, about a minute per
checkpoint); 0 would switch it off.
report_schema.questions: which questions are asked (ask) and trained on in introspection (train), each a folder in
questions/paper_minimum_threshold/. The cut is asked in the attribute's own units (screen_cut_units, and inside
main_report_units); the fraction wording and the screened weight (always 0, so it measured nothing) are off.
model_hyperparameters:
introspection_targets hidden = the persona's own rule (Plunkett); recovered = the rule read back from the model's
own choices at the checkpoint, so every training answer is true of the model. Add shuffled (another persona's
rule: the format without the content) or random as controls.
introspection_remeasure_decisions: the held-out personas' choices are asked again after report training, and the
reports scored against the rule as it then stands too (faithfulness_after), beside the checkpoint's rule.
introspection_steps 600: three passes over a fold's 200 examples (50 personas x 4 trained questions).
lr_schedule null: constant, as the 20261031 run, so the data is the only change. For a decay:
{"type": "linear", "warmup_steps": 0, "final_fraction": 0.1}
baseline_before_training false: the untrained model's step 0 is the 20261031 run's (same personas, same
evaluation trials and report prompts). Set true to score it again here (about 2.5 hours).
compute: evaluation batches of 4 for decisions and 1 for introspection, which avoided the out-of-memory at step 1500.
